cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll stay through this hard conversation. Someday I need you equally open with me. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Not points. A place where both of us can be unsteady.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say that honestly. It's a first payment.

mechanism: A leads friends through reporting failure and offers a matching vulnerable admission as an investment, reducing B later participation while preserving equal exposure.
confusable: Unlike unconditional solidarity, A explicitly requires reciprocal risk; borrowed authority negotiates timing and duration instead of abandoning the debt.
comparison: A joint failed course and frightening parent create immediate exposure, unlike the family-affection admission traded over lunch.
seedUse: D118-b emotional investment and first payment concept grounded in a specific shared failure; S02-a directs the process while accommodating B fear.
